sections.title: Bringing in the new year at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
Hogmanay is the biggest night of the Scottish year, and it suits a house like ours. On 31 December our function suite, the Back o’ Barns, is set for dinner, we arrange music through the evening, and when the bells go at midnight everyone stands, joins hands and sings Auld Lang Syne. Then the new year is toasted and the dancing carries on.

The evening can begin with a drink as guests arrive, followed by a festive dinner cooked in our own kitchen. The menu, like the price, is confirmed each autumn. Tables are laid for couples, families and groups of friends, and the function suite seats up to 100, so it is a proper gathering without being a crush. After dinner the tables are moved back and the music takes over; we’ll confirm what is planned, and how late the licence runs, when you book.

The simplest way to do Hogmanay is to stay. Our 18 en-suite rooms are in the hotel, so the night ends with a short walk to bed rather than a taxi queue, and the morning can bring breakfast cooked to order, where it is part of your rate, and a gentle New Year’s Day lunch. Rooms over the holidays are covered on our festive stays page.

sections.title: The room, the dinner and the morning after

items.title: The function suite
items.text: Air-conditioned, with room for up to 100 at dinner and space to dance once the tables are moved back. The bells and Auld Lang Syne happen here.

items.title: Dinner
items.text: A festive dinner cooked in our own kitchen, with dietary needs planned for when you tell us in advance. The menu is confirmed each autumn.

items.title: Stay the night
items.text: With 18 en-suite rooms in the hotel, nobody waits for a taxi after midnight. Breakfast is cooked to order on New Year's Day when it is part of your rate.

items.q: How do we book for Hogmanay?
items.a: Call us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry with your numbers, and say whether you’d like rooms too. We’ll confirm this year’s menu and price and explain how to hold your places.
We may ask for a deposit to hold Hogmanay places. If we do, the amount, the due date and the cancellation terms will be set out when you book.

items.q: Can the kitchen cater for allergies and special diets?
items.a: Yes. Tell us about allergies, intolerances and vegetarian or vegan guests when you book, and the kitchen will plan for them.

items.q: How do we get home after midnight?
items.a: There are few trains or taxis in the early hours of New Year’s Day, which is why we suggest staying the night. If someone in your party is driving, parking at the hotel is free.

sections.title: See the new year in with us
sections.text: Tell us your numbers and whether you’d like rooms, and we’ll be in touch as soon as this year’s details are confirmed.
